site.tagline: Anonymous employee reviews of companies: salaries, culture, management.
site.supportIntro: {{appName}} is a free mobile app, available on iOS and Android, to read and publish anonymous reviews of companies.
site.contactText: A question, a sign-in problem, a request about your data? Write to {{contactEmail}}. We reply within a few business days.
site.passwordText: On the sign-in screen, choose “Forgot password” and enter your email address. Open the link you receive on your phone: it opens the app so you can choose a new password.
site.reportText: In the app, open the review’s “…” menu and choose “Report this review”. You can also write to {{abuseEmail}}, stating the company name, the review concerned and your reasons.
site.deleteAccountIntro: This page explains how to delete your {{appName}} account and its associated data, from the app or by email.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: {{appName}} (the “Service”) is a mobile app, available on iOS and Android, that lets you read and publish anonymous reviews of companies: culture, pay, management, benefits. These terms govern its use; accepting them is required to sign in.

sections.heading: 2. Publisher
paragraphs: The Service is published by an individual who can be reached at {{contactEmail}} (see the legal notice, available from the “Account” screen of the app).

sections.heading: 3. Access to the Service
paragraphs: Company pages and reviews can be read freely without an account.

Publishing a review, voting, reporting content or adding a company requires an account, created with an email address and password, or through Apple or Google. You must be at least 16, provide a valid email address and create only one account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential.
The Service is free. It contains no advertising and no in-app purchases.

sections.heading: 4. Content rules
paragraphs: A review must describe your own, genuine experience at the company concerned, and remain factual and measured. Each account may post one review per company; you can edit or delete it at any time.

The following are prohibited: names or details that could identify a person (colleague, manager, client); accusations against a person; abusive, defamatory, discriminatory, hateful or threatening content; personal data (email, phone number, address); confidential information or trade secrets; fake reviews (written by the company, a competitor, in exchange for payment or without having worked there); advertising; any unlawful content.
The salaries you declare are published without any link to your identity. Do not enter an amount if, combined with your job title, it could make you recognisable.

sections.heading: 5. Moderation and reporting
paragraphs: {{appName}} acts as a hosting provider for the reviews published by its users (article 6 of the French law on confidence in the digital economy and Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 on digital services). Reviews are not systematically checked before publication. However, automated filters, including a text analysis tool supplied by a service provider, may reject a review or hold it for review before publication.

Every review can be reported from its “…” menu, “Report this review” option. Anyone can also notify unlawful content to {{abuseEmail}}, stating the company name, the content concerned, the reasons why it is unlawful and their contact details. Notices are handled diligently and objectively; manifestly unlawful content is removed promptly. A review that receives many reports is hidden automatically pending review.

The status of each review (published, under review, hidden, removed) is visible to its author from their account. The author of a removed or hidden review can ask for the reasons and challenge the decision by writing to {{contactEmail}}; the request is reviewed by a person.
In case of repeated or serious breaches of these rules, the account concerned may be suspended or deleted, after the situation has been examined.

sections.heading: 6. Anonymity
paragraphs: Your name and email address are never displayed. Reviews are published without any identifier and dated to the month.

As long as your account exists, judicial authorities may obtain the data we hold upon request; once it is deleted, we keep none. Avoid including details in your review that could make you recognisable.

sections.heading: 7. Your content
paragraphs: You keep the rights to your reviews. You grant the Service a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, reproduce and display them in the app, worldwide, for as long as they are published. Deleting a review ends this licence.

sections.heading: 8. Reviewed companies
paragraphs: A company can report a review it considers unlawful to {{abuseEmail}}, under the conditions of section 5. Company pages are created from the INSEE SIRENE register. No review can be removed, edited or promoted in exchange for payment, and no company can request the deletion of its page solely because its reviews are unfavourable.

sections.heading: 9. Liability
paragraphs: Each author is solely responsible for the content they publish. Reviews reflect the opinion of their authors, not that of the publisher. The Service is provided as is; we strive to keep it available but cannot guarantee it.

sections.heading: 10. Account deletion
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from the “Account” screen, “Delete my account” button. All your data is then erased immediately and permanently (email address, reviews, votes, reports, hidden authors); no copy is kept.

sections.heading: 11. Changes and governing law
paragraphs: These terms may change; significant changes will be announced in the app before they take effect.

These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, please contact us first at {{contactEmail}} to seek an amicable solution. Failing that, the dispute will be brought before the competent French courts; if you are a consumer, you may bring it before the courts of your place of residence, and the protective rules of your country of residence continue to apply.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is the publisher of the {{appName}} app, an individual. Contact for any question about your data: {{contactEmail}}.

sections.heading: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: Account: email address, password (stored hashed, never in plain text), creation and last sign-in dates. If you sign in with Apple or Google, we receive your email address from that provider (possibly a relay address hidden by Apple) and a technical identifier, never your password.

Contributions: reviews (ratings, texts, job title, contract type, declared salary), “helpful” votes, reports and hidden authors. Reviews are published without any identifier; the link between your account and your reviews is kept internally so you can edit them and to enforce the one-review-per-company rule, until your account is deleted.
Anti-abuse data: when you publish, your IP address is recorded in hashed (irreversible) form to limit bursts of submissions.
Crash reports: when the app crashes, technical information (device model, system and app version, error trace) is sent to our diagnostics tool, without your email address.
Analytics: only if you agree, we measure the screens viewed and the device type. These statistics are never linked to your account.
Preferences: your language, your answers to the welcome questionnaire and your display choices stay on your device and are not sent to us.
We do not collect your location, contacts or photos, and we do not use any advertising identifier.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Providing the Service (account, publishing, votes, reports, password reset): performance of the terms of use.
Preventing spam and abuse, moderating content, securing the Service, diagnosing errors: legitimate interest.
Responding to judicial requests concerning existing data: legal obligation.
Analytics: consent, which you can withdraw at any time from the “Account” screen.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Your data is never sold or used for advertising. It is processed by our service providers, strictly within the scope of their mission:
Supabase Pte. Ltd. (Singapore): database and authentication, data hosted in France (Paris) on Amazon Web Services infrastructure.

OpenAI Ireland Ltd (Ireland): automated moderation of review texts, sent without any identifier. Texts may be processed in the United States by OpenAI, L.L.C.; this transfer is covered by the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses. Texts are not used to train OpenAI’s models.
Google Ireland Ltd: sign-in with Google if you choose it.
1&1 Mail & Media GmbH (GMX, Germany): sending password reset emails.
Tutao GmbH (Tuta, Germany): encrypted mailbox of the contact address, which receives your requests and reports by email.

GitHub, Inc. (United States): hosting of the information web pages (support and legal documents), which technically logs their visitors’ IP addresses; transfer covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
Apple Distribution International Ltd: sign-in with Apple if you choose it.
Functional Software, Inc. (Sentry): crash reports, data hosted in the European Union (Germany).
PostHog, Inc.: analytics, only with your consent, data hosted in the European Union.
650 Industries, Inc. (Expo, United States): delivery of app updates, transfer covered by standard contractual clauses.
Judicial authorities may obtain certain data upon request.

sections.heading: 5. Retention periods
paragraphs: Account, reviews, votes, reports and hidden authors: until your account or the content concerned is deleted.
Hashed IP addresses: 30 days.

Account deletion: all data linked to the account (email address, reviews, votes, reports, hidden authors, hashed IP addresses) is erased immediately and permanently. No copy or archive is kept. Only company pages remain, taken from the public SIRENE register and not linked to your account.
Crash reports: 90 days at most.
Requests sent by email (exercise of rights, content notices): three years from the last exchange, to evidence how they were handled.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, as well as the right to set instructions regarding your data after your death. Account deletion is available directly in the app. For other requests, write to {{contactEmail}} from your account’s email address; we reply within one month.
You can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (www.cnil.fr).

sections.heading: 7. Deleting your account
paragraphs: In the app: open the “Account” tab, tap “Delete my account”, then “Delete permanently”. Deletion is immediate: your email address, reviews, votes, reports and hidden authors are erased, with no copy kept.
If you no longer have access to the app, write to {{contactEmail}} from your account’s email address asking for its deletion. It is carried out within 30 days and you receive a confirmation.

sections.heading: 8. Security and on-device storage
paragraphs: Connections are encrypted, passwords hashed and access to data restricted by database-level security rules.

The app stores on your device your sign-in session (strictly necessary), your language, your preferences and your consent choice. Analytics are only enabled after you agree and use no advertising identifier.
The information web pages use no cookies and no analytics.

sections.heading: 9. Minors
paragraphs: The Service is reserved for people aged 16 or over. If you become aware that a child under 16 has created an account, write to {{contactEmail}}: the account will be deleted.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: This policy may change. You will be informed in the app of any significant change.

sections.heading: Publisher
paragraphs: {{appName}} is published by an individual. In accordance with article 6-III-2 of the French law on confidence in the digital economy, their identification details have been provided to the hosting provider.
Email: {{contactEmail}}

sections.heading: Publication director
paragraphs: The publisher, who can be reached at {{contactEmail}}.

sections.heading: Hosting
paragraphs: Data and authentication: Supabase Pte. Ltd., 65 Chulia Street #38-02/03, OCBC Centre, Singapore 049513. Data stored in France (Paris) on Amazon Web Services infrastructure.
Information web pages: GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States.
The apps are distributed by Apple (App Store) and Google (Google Play).

sections.heading: Reporting unlawful content
paragraphs: Use the “Report this review” option in the “…” menu of each review, or write to {{abuseEmail}}. Single point of contact under the Digital Services Act (DSA), for authorities and users alike: {{abuseEmail}} (French, English).
